note: _haec vinea erat Naboth Hiezrahelitae qui erat in Hiezrahel_ – this vineyard was of Nabot the Jezrehalite, who (_qui_) was in Jezrahel. This is the Weber/Gryson reading. But the text requires _quae_, referring to the vineyard. Modern editions of the Clementia have the correct reading: _quae_, e.g., the editions of Loch, Hetzenauer, and Colunga/Turrado.
